test_update_frequency_training: test the MMF trainer training loop with different update frequency configurations and batch sizes
test_nan_loss_handling: test that the MMF trainer raises a RuntimeError when the model produces NaN losses during training
test_fractional_epoch_training: test the MMF trainer training loop with fractional epoch values to verify correct update calculation
test_batch_size_per_device: test the MMF trainer batch size per device calculation with mocked world size for distributed training
